claims.claim: Camera quality samples use192px long edge every250ms at most; stable1000ms/cooldown1800ms/max6 are current settings, not optimized thresholds.
Camera path has audio:false and no MediaRecorder; selected current full-size frames becomeJPEG(.94).
Upload queue is sequential with96MiB UTF16dataURL accounting; changing API selection after upload does not save those uploaded bytes.
Current fingerprint-only accepted set lacks quality-aware replacement of a similar view.
Global similarity may confuse repeated board areas or exclude a useful glare-free view; incidence is not measured.
Local quality/novelty gate, variable API-selected representative set, bounded call/image/output plan, optional targeted follow-up. Keep ongoing bundle implementation unblocked.
Game-specific optimal counts, phone CPU/battery, spatial coverage quality, token savings and end-to-end correction/save time.
